title: Kissed Light Vietnamese Chestnut Cha Gio
description: A briny and bouncy Vietnamese dish featuring cooked chestnut, clay-pot-cooked to perfection, with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients, served in a bamboo tray as cha gio.
instructions: Soak the rice paper sheets in warm water for 30 seconds to soften them.
Combine the cooked chestnuts, mung bean noodles, carrots, cilantro, and scallions in a bowl.
Add the fish sauce, lime juice, and sesame oil to the bowl and mix well.
Lay a softened rice paper sheet on a flat surface and place about 1 tablespoon of the chestnut mixture in the center of the sheet.
Fold the bottom half of the sheet up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the sheet to form a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients to make about 12 cha gio.
Serve the cha gio in a bamboo tray with your favorite dipping sauce.
Garnish with additional cilantro and scallions if desired.
Cook the cha gio in a clay pot over low heat for 5 minutes to warm them through.
